findings.title: Initialization and Ollama contracts drifted from server
findings.observed: Model list/check tried to decode data instead of data.models; model checks discarded available/dimension; download sent model instead of modelName and lost data.taskId; initialization sent unsupported flat IDs.
findings.fix: Use nested connection/splitting settings, explicit existing-model binding wrapper, current model list/check envelopes, normalized available result and taskId.

findings.title: Multimodal model test could not supply required image
findings.observed: SDK sent JSON; handler requires multipart image and form values.
findings.fix: Accept exactly one local image path, build multipart image/form request, preserve auth/context and close response. Old image-less invocation fails with clear error before request.

findings.title: DocReader reconnect silently reports connection failures as success
findings.observed: Server returns HTTP 200 with code=1 on connection failure, SDK discarded body.
findings.fix: Decode code/msg and return application failure.

findings.title: Chunk updates write omitted fields and discard optimistic revision
findings.observed: Content-only edit sends is_enabled=false; toggle sends empty content; no expected_revision or returned content_revision retained.
findings.fix: Use pointer optional update fields; add expected/content revision; remove unsupported request fields; adapt only in-repo caller example.

findings.title: Generated-question deletion uses an unregistered route
findings.observed: DELETE /chunks/{id}/delete-question does not match the actual question-deletion handler.
findings.fix: Use DELETE /chunks/by-id/{id}/questions with question_id JSON body.

findings.title: Shared-resource lists discard the actual resource
findings.observed: Returned entries retain share metadata but drop knowledge_base/agent identity; callers cannot identify or open returned shared resources.
findings.fix: Preserve typed embedded KB/agent and current agent availability/sharing metadata.

findings.title: Organization SDK still exposes user-based member semantics
findings.observed: Search sends keyword and parses UserInfo but backend compatibility route expects q=exact tenant ID and returns tenant candidates; old update/remove put userID into tenant_id path and can mutate a numerically matching workspace.
findings.fix: Add explicit uint64 SearchTenantsForInvite/InviteTenantMember/UpdateTenantMemberRole/RemoveTenantMember. Old user search/update/remove return migration errors without HTTP. Keep InviteMember only because backend deliberately resolves user_id to a workspace, with accurate deprecated docs. Add roster workspace metadata and examples.

findings.title: Explicit handle resource mode inherits public server default
findings.observed: SDK omits resource_urls=handle, so RESOURCE_URL_MODE=public wins despite explicit client choice.
findings.fix: Only omit nil/empty option; send handle and public explicitly. Correct previous unit expectation and add response-level default-override fixture.

findings.title: Agent GET-to-PUT loses operational and permission settings
findings.observed: Nine server config fields absent from SDK: read_only access_level disappears (empty defaults auto_write), memory opt-out disappears, sandbox/parser/attachment/intent settings reset. CLI agent edit uses GET-to-PUT.
findings.fix: Add all nine current missing CustomAgentConfig fields with matching wire types and tags, including pointer memory opt-out. No handler/CLI changes.

findings.title: FAQ export returns HTTP failures as successful CSV
findings.observed: 401/403/404/500 JSON error bodies are returned as []byte with nil error.
findings.fix: Check HTTP status before reading CSV and return bounded typed APIError; preserve successful CSV/BOM bytes.

additional_review.route_check: Compared literal SDK paths to normalized Swagger route paths, then checked router source for missing entries. Tenant API-key and agent-sharing routes are registered despite Swagger gaps; generated-question stale path was the confirmed mismatch.
additional_review.type_check: Compared matching Swagger primitive property types as a supplemental check; source handlers remained authoritative. Explicit CustomAgentConfig JSON-field comparison found the nine missing fields.
additional_review.transport: Retained centralized auth/context/path/redirect/error/SSE behaviors; ran the whole existing SDK suite under race detector. No live credentials, API requests or provider services used.

api_compatibility: Chunk update Content/IsEnabled are now pointers; obsolete unsupported fields removed. Only in-repo direct caller was example.go and is adapted. External callers must use pointers and should send expected_revision from a read.
Old organization user search/update/remove retain signatures but fail locally with migration guidance; they never reinterpret a user ID as workspace ID. Explicit workspace APIs use uint64 IDs.
Initialization callers using old flat IDs should use SetKBModelConfig; image test callers must supply one image path. Existing in-repo CLI model binding uses unchanged SetKBModelConfig.
limits: This audits the existing SDK surface, not all backend-only endpoints or every newer optional metadata field; no expansion to the complete server API was attempted.

Handler contracts are checked against source and isolated httptest wire fixtures. The client module is separate and fixtures do not run the real authenticated router, external LLM/Ollama/docreader/vector services, or database authorization.

No live upload/download, tenant mutation, invitation, provider connection or deployment operation was performed. Multipart buffering behavior follows the existing SDK; no large-file memory benchmark performed.
No future unknown-field preservation added to AgentConfig. All current server fields are represented; future server config additions still require SDK updates.
Full CLI/repository build and final local commit are owned by root. Evaluation is reported separately in evaluation.json.
